messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great progress! The SIM card is now recognized and you have excellent signal. Enabling mobile data won't affect your photos or calls—it simply allows your phone to use the cellular network for internet access (and MMS requires this).

Please go ahead and use the `toggle_data` action on your phone to turn mobile data ON. This is safe and reversible if needed.

Once you've done that, let me know what the status bar shows (especially whether data is now enabled), and we'll test MMS or proceed to the next step if needed.

I have turned mobile data on. The status bar now shows excellent 4G signal with 5G and data enabled. Should I try sending the MMS message again now to see if it works?

Please process the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
